verdict.rationale: Docs confirm you can watch agent sessions execute live and capture rrweb/MP4 recordings, supporting the observability half of the story, but there is no evidence of a mechanism for a human to take over control of the browser mid-run when the agent stalls. Missing for 10: documented live human takeover/interactive control API, hands-on confirmation of handoff, and any UI showing manual intervention during an active agent run.
